definitions: Expressing the meaning of (something written or spoken) using different words, especially to achieve greater clarity.
Restating a text or passage in another form or other words, often to simplify or clarify.
examples: She was paraphrasing the professor's lecture notes.
The student was paraphrasing the complex legal text.
He spent the afternoon paraphrasing the historical document.
pastTenses: paraphrased (past simple), paraphrased (present perfect), paraphrased (past perfect)
